title: Install
note: One binary (a single program file). You do not install a runtime first, and no background process keeps running.

title: Create
note: Creates a page, two components, a service and a controller. Each one goes in its own folder.

title: Serve
note: Rebuilds the sources you change. Some changes can use a hot update: the page updates in place and keeps its declared state. Other changes reload the page.
